articles.title: Ghost Prism
articles.summary: Black field with faint grey ghost shapes and offset red, green and blue spectral echoes, like a double exposure. Reads as black cracked glass with a web of silver lines and a handful of coloured glints; the cracks stay visible, flares blur to specks.
articles.what: ★ Spectrum Shift — Ghost Prism: Double-exposure spectroscopy: an attractor motif and its R/G/B ghosts offset in three directions — spectral echo art. Up close: Looks like a photo of shattered glass: a black field split into irregular polygon shards, 60-250 px, by thin bright silver crack lines that fork and meet at star-shaped nodes. Tiny rainbow flares of orange, red, blue and violet glow at some crack junctions, and a few soft pale blurs sit inside. From a distance: Reads as black cracked glass with a web of silver lines and a handful of coloured glints; the cracks stay visible, flares blur to specks. Measured spec (average): metal 54, roughness 102, coat 27. Shine: satin. Metal: low. It brings its own colours.

articles.title: Oilfilm Rain
articles.summary: Dark wet asphalt slick with faint rainbow oil sheen, drain streaks and rain-ring marks over brown-black. A dark earthy brown-olive camo-like surface with purple blotches; the ripple rings blur away and it reads as muddy tarmac with a violet stain.

Violet zones carry sets of concentric ripple rings, 3 px lines, like raindrop impact marks, and a few streaks flow between them. Tiny blue and grey flecks sit along the patch edges.
